hook: Jason Furman is the Aetna Professor of the Practice of Economic Policy at Harvard, jointly at Harvard Kennedy School and the Department of Economics, and the Weil Director of the school's Mossavar-Rahmani Center for Business and Government. From 2013 to 2017 he was the 28th Chair of the Council of Economic Advisers, President Obama's chief economist. In October 2026 he launched Econvitals, a free public site on the health of the US economy, which Axios reported he built largely with AI.

editor_points.desc: Runs Econvitals, a free public site on the health of the US economy, launched in October 2026. Axios reported that he built it largely with Claude, with OpenAI's Codex used to cross-check, and that it scores Federal Reserve officials' speeches as hawkish or dovish and summarizes new research and data.
